text:
cheng: @sarah FYI helm upgrade for inference-runtime (chart v2.4.1) failed in our staging cluster. Release went to FAILED because a pre-upgrade hook Job is stuck Pending and never schedules. Argo shows the app as OutOfSync. Anyone seen this?

sarah: can you paste the job + pod events and the helm output? even a short `kubectl describe` is fine.

cheng: paste from cluster: 

```
$ kubectl get pods -n infra
NAME                                      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
schema-migrate-5xk7f-0                   0/1     Pending   0          4m

$ kubectl describe pod schema-migrate-5xk7f-0 -n infra
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age    From               Message
  ----     ------            ----   ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  3m22s  default-scheduler  0/12 nodes are available: 8 node(s) didn't match node selector, 4 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
```

cheng: helm logs show: `pre-upgrade hook "job" failed: timed out waiting for the condition` then release marked FAILED.

sanjay: looks like the hook pod has a nodeSelector that targets GPU nodes (`nvidia.com/gpu: present`), but this migration job shouldn't need GPUs. probably a templating bug where the chart's global nodeSelector leaked into hook templates. quick checks: `helm get manifest inference-runtime | grep -A5 "schema-migrate"` or inspect values for `global.nodeSelector` usage.

elaine: we also have low spare GPU capacity in eu-west-1 today — don't schedule non-GPU workloads onto GPU nodes.

cheng: confirmed the job manifest includes: 

```
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        nvidia.com/gpu: "present"
```

sanjay: short-term remediation options: 
- Option A (fast): delete the hook Job so Helm can re-run the upgrade (or you can `helm rollback` to previous revision). `kubectl delete job schema-migrate-5xk7f -n infra` then `helm rollback inference-runtime 3` (or re-run upgrade after fix).
- Option B (minimal change): recreate the Job without the nodeSelector so it can schedule: `kubectl apply -f corrected-job.yaml -n infra` (use a new name so hook ID won't conflict).
- Option C (safe): patch chart to remove nodeSelector from hook template and cut a quick chart patch, then `helm upgrade --install` once chart is updated.

cheng: heads up: I tried deleting the job but Helm still shows the release as FAILED (helm keeps history). Argo refuses to sync because the live resource state doesn't match git. Rollback seems safest for staging.

elaine: let's also add a pipeline preflight that checks for hook templates referencing `global.nodeSelector` or GPU labels. low-cost guard: a simple `grep` in CI that fails the chart release if hooks reference `nvidia.com/gpu` or `nodeSelector`. I'll own a quick PR for that.

sanjay: I'll open a hotfix PR to remove the nodeSelector from the hook templates and bump chart patch to v2.4.2. After CI passes we can `helm upgrade` again and Argo should reconcile. If we want to avoid blocking, we can `helm rollback` to v2.4.0 in staging now.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline inference-runtime-chart #342 failed at step: helm-upgrade-hook (exit code 1). See https://ci.internal/reports/342 for logs.

cheng: action items:
- sanjay: PR to remove nodeSelector from hooks and bump chart (owner)
- elaine: add preflight grep check in chart pipeline (owner)
- sarah: try helm rollback in staging to unblock Argo (owner)
- cheng: will monitor GPU capacity and mark eu-west-1 as low-cap in the release notes (:warning:)

sarah: on it, rolling back now. Will report when Argo shows sync OK. :thumbsup:
